{{Quote|Ghorman was the scene of an early massacre, portent of the future of the Empire. A peaceful demonstration against rising taxes turned to tragedy and horror as the Republic warship sent to collect the taxes landed despite the protesters, killing or injuring hundreds.|The pamphlet ''[[A Call to Reason]]'' distributed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]|<ref name="Farlander">{{StoryCite|story=The Farlander Papers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}</ref>}}
The [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]]<ref name="RAS" /> had a '''primary spaceport'''.<ref name="Technical Journal">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Rebel Forces]]''</ref> In approximately [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Ghorman Massacre Date">{{FactFile|31|TAR 1-4|Grand Moff Tarkin}} states that the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]] took place shortly after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> hundreds of [[Ghormanian]]s attended a<ref name="RAS" /> peaceful sit-in protest at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] landing pads in opposition to a new tax by<ref name="RAS" /> the recently [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]]<ref name="Fact File 31">{{FactFile|31|TAR 1-4|Grand Moff Tarkin}}</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] arrived in a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] to collect the taxes<ref name="RAS" /> and ordered his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]<ref name="Fact File 31" /> to land on top of the protestors,<ref name="RAS" /> killing<ref name="Farlander" /> and injuring hundreds in what became known as the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="RAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ghorman's spaceport was first mentioned in [[1990]]'s ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Paul Murphy]].<ref name="RAS" /> The magazine ''[[Star Wars Annual 1999]]'' stated that multiple warships landed at the spaceport during the Ghorman Massacre,<ref name="Annual 99">''[[Star Wars Annual 1999]]''</ref> while all other sources only mention that Tarkin's warship landed.<ref name="RAS" /><ref name="Farlander" /><ref name="Technical Journal" /><ref name="Fact File 31" /> The [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]] stated that the massacre occurred at Ghorman's [[Ghorman capital square|capital square]] rather than the spaceport.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> This article follows the majority of sources that place the massacre at the spaceport.
